# galloc

> O(1) offset allocator for sub-allocating one contiguous range, such as a GPU heap or buffer. Allocation and free
> take constant time, and adjacent free regions merge on free. A Go port of Sebastian Aaltonen's C++
> OffsetAllocator. 256 size bins (SmallFloat encoding, at most 12.5% overhead per allocation), aligned allocation,
> no heap allocation after `New`, and a mutex-wrapped `SyncAllocator` for concurrent use. Pure Go, standard library
> only, zero CGO, Go 1.25+. Pre-1.0: the API may change before v1.0.
